problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to load cargo boxes onto identical pallets.  
Cargo items:  
* Box A: 51kg  
* Box B: 45kg  
* Box C: 38kg  
* Box D: 53kg  
* Box E: 62kg  
* Box F: 43kg  
* Box G: 64kg  
* Box H: 55kg  
* Box I: 34kg  
* Box J: 38kg  
* Box K: 56kg  
* Box L: 66kg  
* Box M: 52kg  
* Box N: 36kg  
* Box O: 57kg  
* Box P: 57kg  
* Box Q: 45kg  
* Box R: 60kg  
* Box S: 54kg  
* Box T: 44kg  

Each pallet has a maximum load capacity of 100kg.  
Load all boxes using the fewest pallets. Every box must be placed on exactly one pallet, and the total weight on a pallet must not exceed its capacity.
